verdict.rationale: Relay's support docs say you can freeze a card instantly from the Cards screen in the app and order a replacement, which typically arrives in 5–7 business days. Relay issues physical and virtual Visa cards to team members, so a finance lead would plausibly manage this. missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the freeze/replace flow, and no detail on whether admins can freeze cards held by other team members.
